mapper.select: SELECT C_PROJECT_SEQ SEQ, S_PROJECT_NM PROJECT_NM, S_TAG TAG, S_SUM_IMG SUM_IMG, C_START_DY START_DY, C_END_DY END_DY, S_DETAIL_IMG DETAIL_IMG, S_DETAIL_CONT DETAIL_CONT, C_USE_YN USE_YN FROM T_LD_PROJECT_INFO ORDER BY C_PROJECT_SEQ DESC

SELECT C_PROJECT_SEQ SEQ, S_PROJECT_NM PROJECT_NM, S_TAG TAG, S_SUM_IMG SUM_IMG, C_START_DY START_DY, C_END_DY END_DY, S_DETAIL_IMG DETAIL_IMG, S_DETAIL_CONT DETAIL_CONT, C_USE_YN USE_YN FROM T_LD_PROJECT_INFO WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_LD_PROJECT_INFO (C_PROJECT_SEQ, S_PROJECT_NM, S_TAG, S_SUM_IMG, C_START_DY, C_END_DY, S_DETAIL_IMG, S_DETAIL_CONT, C_USE_YN, S_REG_ID, D_REG_DT) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(C_PROJECT_SEQ), 0) + 1, #{projectNm}, #{tag}, #{sumImg}, #{startDy}, #{endDy}, #{detailImg}, #{detailCont}, 'Y', 'admin', NOW() FROM T_LD_PROJECT_INFO
mapper.update: UPDATE T_LD_PROJECT_INFO SET S_PROJECT_NM = #{projectNm}, S_TAG = #{tag}, S_SUM_IMG = #{sumImg}, C_START_DY = #{startDy}, C_END_DY = #{endDy}, S_DETAIL_IMG = #{detailImg}, S_DETAIL_CONT = #{detailCont} WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
UPDATE T_LD_PROJECT_INFO SET C_USE_YN = 'N' WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
UPDATE T_LD_PROJECT_INFO SET C_USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{seq}
